articles.author: Jake Trotter
articles.title: Ohio State QB Julian Sayin out 'several weeks' with shoulder injury - ESPN
articles.description: Ohio State's Julian Sayin will miss "several weeks" with an injury to his throwing shoulder, coach Ryan Day said Saturday after his team escaped with a 19-15 victory at No. 5 Indiana, a game in which Luke Fahey finished up as the Buckeyes' quarterback.
articles.content:
